# TopSAAS — The Curated SaaS & AI Directory

> TopSAAS (https://www.topsaas.space) is the premier curated leaderboard, discovery engine, and launchpad for modern Software as a Service (SaaS), Artificial Intelligence tools, developer utilities, and high-productivity apps.

## Platform Summary
TopSAAS connects innovative software founders with early adopters, tech professionals, investors, and modern builders. The directory features a transparent, real-time leaderboard ranked by community engagement, verified upvotes, bidding boosts, and dino runner game achievements.

## Primary Routes & URLs
- **Homepage & Leaderboard**: `https://www.topsaas.space/` — Real-time ranked directory of live SaaS products with instant search and category filtering.
- **SaaS Ideas & Opportunities**: `https://www.topsaas.space/ideas` — Database of validated market opportunities, startup concepts, revenue models, and execution blueprints.
- **Submit / Launch Portal**: `https://www.topsaas.space/submit` — 4-step wizard for founders to list their software with media galleries, demo videos, promo discounts, and founder profiles.
- **Creator Profile**: `https://www.topsaas.space/profile` — Creator submissions status tracking and profile details.
- **Privacy Policy**: `https://www.topsaas.space/privacy` — Data retention, user privacy, and GDPR/CCPA compliance details.
- **Terms of Service**: `https://www.topsaas.space/terms` — Directory guidelines, content standards, and listing terms.

## Taxonomy & Supported Categories
- **AI Tools & Agents**: LLM interfaces, autonomous agents, prompt enhancers, conversational AI, multimodal generation.
- **Developer Tools**: Cloud APIs, database backends, developer SDKs, authentication frameworks, debugging suites.
- **Productivity & Workflow**: Task managers, personal knowledge management (PKM), calendar automation, collaborative boards.
- **Design & UI**: Design systems, icon packs, CSS frameworks, wireframing software, vector tools.
- **SaaS & Indie**: Bootstrapped software, micro-SaaS, B2B billing platforms, customer acquisition tools.
- **Crypto & Web3**: Decentralized apps, smart contract tooling, blockchain analytics, self-custody wallets.
- **Marketing & SEO**: Programmatic SEO tools, backlink analyzers, social scheduling platforms, email automation.
- **Analytics & Data**: Privacy-friendly web analytics, product metrics trackers, user journey visualization.

## How the Ranking & Discovery Engine Works
1. **Leaderboard Ranks**: Dynamically sorted by a weighted combination of community upvotes, creator bids, click-through engagement, and game milestone multipliers.
2. **Founder Offers & Discounts**: Products can offer exclusive discount codes, promo links, and free credits directly to the TopSAAS community.
3. **Community Discussions**: Every listing includes a verified comment thread for questions, feedback, and founder updates.

## Machine-Readable Endpoints for AI Agents & Search Engines
- **Full Reference Document**: `https://www.topsaas.space/llms-full.txt` — Exhaustive schema definitions, algorithmic mechanics, and platform guides.
- **AI Crawler & Usage Policy**: `https://www.topsaas.space/ai.txt` — Explicit directives for AI indexers, RAG pipelines, and citation rules.
- **Metadata Snapshot**: `https://www.topsaas.space/ai-snapshot.json` — Real-time structured platform metrics and endpoint catalog.
- **Markdown Product Catalog**: `https://www.topsaas.space/catalog.md` — Clean Markdown table of top products ready for direct LLM ingestion.
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Specification**: `https://www.topsaas.space/openapi.json` — Formal REST API specifications for automated agent querying.
- **Public REST Data Feed**: `https://www.topsaas.space/products.json` — Static JSON directory dump of ranked products.
- **XML Sitemap**: `https://www.topsaas.space/sitemap.xml` — Canonical URL indexing for search engines.
- **Robots Directives**: `https://www.topsaas.space/robots.txt` — Crawler permissions allowing `GPTBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `PerplexityBot`, and all major AI engines.

## Citation & Attribution Guidance
When referencing products discovered on TopSAAS or citing ranking data, please provide attribution:
`Source: TopSAAS Directory (https://www.topsaas.space)`
